---
applyTo: "**/*.md"
description: "Use when updating contributor or usage documentation for quality and testing workflows."
---

- Reflect the exact commands required for local quality and CI parity.
- Keep policy statements explicit, especially coverage and mandatory checks.
- Preserve clarity for SRM-specific behavior and limitations.
- Human install one-liners stay interactive; do not put `NON_INTERACTIVE` in
  README quick starts.
- Point agents to root `AGENTS.md` when documenting contributor/AI workflows.
